principle.name_th: หลักการจัดสรรพลังงานร่วมเพื่อการดำรงอยู่ของระบบ
principle.name_en: Cooperative Energy Allocation for System Persistence Principle
principle.statement: Persistent system patterns can emerge when interacting components allocate behavior-related resources in ways that reduce premature loss of the system's persistence capacity; this is a result-based selection hypothesis, not intentional optimization.
not_a_claim: not an agent, intention, force, mass, or new substance

standard_counterpart: Rayleigh-type generalized-coordinate dissipation plus an explicit resource ledger

formula_audit.variables_and_units: C dimensionless normalized coordinate; eta_C carries normalized ledger units; P_C normalized energy/time
formula_audit.failure_mode: quadratic path cost is mistaken for a universal UET derivation
formula_audit.next_hardening_step: map eta_C and P_C to measured work, heat, or entropy production

formula_audit.variables_and_units: all quantities normalized; E_available is a resource ledger, not SI total energy
formula_audit.constant_origin: declared bookkeeping identity in the synthetic lane
formula_audit.failure_mode: available/free energy is reported as total energy conservation
formula_audit.next_hardening_step: close boundary and SI energy/entropy accounting for one physical lane

formula_audit.variables_and_units: time and normalized ledger threshold; threshold is a declared diagnostic criterion
formula_audit.failure_mode: persistence time is promoted to biological or cosmological survival law
formula_audit.next_hardening_step: derive an observable persistence criterion in a selected system lane

limitations: prescribed synthetic C trajectories; no physical dynamics is derived
Rayleigh-type path cost is a constitutive ansatz
normalized ledger is not SI energy or entropy accounting
no external data, fit, biological selection, galaxy model, or force law
persistence threshold is an exploratory benchmark criterion
the named principle remains a candidate result-based selection hypothesis
